verdict.rationale: Manufact offers some automatic background triggers — deployments fire automatically on push to production branch, and publish checklists can be configured to start automatically after each deployment — but these are CI/CD-style pipeline automations, not autonomous AI agent workflows or scheduled agentic tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of user-defined autonomous agent automations/schedules, task orchestration, or background AI decision-making beyond deploy/checklist triggers.
